bullets.text: US Firms Sue Ofcom - **Ofcom** faces US legal action over alleged free speech violations linked to the **Online Safety Act**.
Speed Fibre Acquires BTCIL - **Speed Fibre Group** completes €22m acquisition of **BT Communications Ireland**, enhancing its network footprint.
eSIM Adoption Challenges - Despite benefits, **eSIM** uptake is hindered by legacy processes and user frustrations.
DDoS Attacks Surge - Over 8 million global **DDoS** attacks recorded in H1 2025, targeting essential services amid geopolitical tensions.
Netomnia Secures £300m - **Netomnia** raises £300m to support its ambitious network expansion across the UK.
Nokia's 5G for Railways - **Nokia** launches a new 5G radio solution aimed at modernizing rail connectivity globally.
